newsitem.title: USA: Boston Chicken comfortable with estimates.
newsitem.headline: Boston Chicken comfortable with estimates.

text.p: Boston Chicken Inc Chief Financial Officer Mark Stephens said on Friday that the family restaurant chain is comfortable with full-year 1996 earnings per share estimates of $0.97.
Stephens said after a presentation to investors at the Montgomery Securities investment conference here that the company plans to add 325 stores in 1997.
Having opened its 1,000th store last week in Boston, he added that the company plans to expand to a total of 4,000 outlets within the next five to seven years.
That estimate is slightly more agressive than earlier plans. In late August the company said it planned 2,700 openings in the coming five to seven years.

Stephens said the higher goal for the domestic U.S. market resulted from a tripling of development commitments by area developers over the last month, with developers now committed to another 2,700 locations over the five-seven year period.
Stephens and Boston Market President and Chief Executive Larry Zwain said they are also exploring expansion internationally.

Zwain said the company thinks the international opportunity is double the domestic opportunity, but because turnover at individual establishments outside the United States is generally higher, this would mean probably at least 4,000 locations eventually, but not as many as double that.
